tool.name: Cell Ranger Count
tool.description: Gene expression from 10x Genomics single-cell RNA-seq data
tool.command:
mkdir -p fastqs &&
## Symlink R1/R2 pairs with CellRanger-expected naming convention #if $input_mode.mode == 'manual': #set $lane = 1 #for $r1, $r2 in zip($input_mode.fastq_r1, $input_mode.fastq_r2): ln -sf '${r1}' fastqs/${sample_id}_S1_L00${lane}_R1_001.fastq.gz && ln -sf '${r2}' fastqs/${sample_id}_S1_L00${lane}_R2_001.fastq.gz && #set $lane = $lane + 1 #end for #else: ## Auto-detect from paired collection #set $lane = 1 #for $pair in $input_mode.fastq_collection: ln -sf '${pair.forward}' fastqs/${sample_id}_S1_L00${lane}_R1_001.fastq.gz && ln -sf '${pair.reverse}' fastqs/${sample_id}_S1_L00${lane}_R2_001.fastq.gz && #set $lane = $lane + 1 #end for #end if
cellranger count --id='${sample_id}' #if str($no_bam) == 'true': --create-bam='false' #else: --create-bam='true' #end if --transcriptome='${transcriptome.fields.path}' --fastqs=fastqs --sample='${sample_id}' --localcores=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-8} --localmem=\$(( \${GALAXY_MEMORY_MB:-65536} / 1024 )) #if $expect_cells: --expect-cells='${expect_cells}' #end if #if $chemistry != 'auto': --chemistry='${chemistry}' #end if --include-introns='${include_introns}' &&
cp '${sample_id}/outs/web_summary.html' '$web_summary' && cp '${sample_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5' '$filtered_matrix' && cp '${sample_id}/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5' '$raw_matrix' && cp '${sample_id}/outs/metrics_summary.csv' '$metrics' && cp '${sample_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz' '$barcodes' && cp '${sample_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz' '$features' && cp '${sample_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz' '$matrix_mtx' && tar -czf '$full_outs' -C '${sample_id}' outs

param.name: mode
param.label: FASTQ input mode
param.help: Choose between manual R1/R2 selection or auto-detect from paired collection.

param.name: fastq_r1
param.label: FASTQ R1 files
param.help: Read 1 FASTQ files containing cell barcode and UMI. Must be paired with R2 files in the same order.

param.name: fastq_r2
param.label: FASTQ R2 files
param.help: Read 2 FASTQ files containing cDNA sequence. Must match R1 files in number and order.

param.name: fastq_collection
param.label: Paired-end FASTQ collection
param.help: Collection containing paired R1/R2 FASTQ files. Galaxy will automatically pair files based on naming.

param.name: sample_id
param.label: Sample ID
param.help: Unique alphanumeric identifier used as the output directory name.

param.name: transcriptome
param.label: Reference transcriptome
param.help: Cell Ranger-compatible reference. Ask your administrator to add entries to cellranger_transcriptomes.loc.

validator.message: No Cell Ranger references are configured on this server.

param.name: expect_cells
param.label: Expected number of cells
param.help: Override Cell Ranger's automatic cell detection. Leave blank to use auto-detection.

param.name: no_bam
param.label: Skip BAM output
param.help: Skip BAM file creation to save storage space and processing time.

param.name: include_introns
param.label: Include intronic reads
param.help: Count reads mapping to pre-mRNA (introns). Recommended for single-nucleus RNA-seq.

tool.help:
**Cell Ranger Count**
Processes Chromium single-cell gene expression FASTQ files by aligning reads to a reference transcriptome and generating feature-barcode count matrices.
**Inputs**
- **R1 / R2 FASTQ files**: Paired gzipped FASTQ files. Multiple lane files can be provided; they must be supplied in matching order (lane 1 R1 paired with lane 1 R2, etc.). - **Reference transcriptome**: Path to a pre-built Cell Ranger reference directory on the server. Build one with ``cellranger mkref`` or download a pre-built reference from 10x Genomics.
**Outputs**
- **Web Summary**: Interactive HTML report with QC metrics and UMAP projection. - **Filtered Feature-Barcode Matrix (h5)**: Count matrix containing only cell-containing barcodes. - **Raw Feature-Barcode Matrix (h5)**: Count matrix for all detected barcodes. - **Metrics Summary**: CSV table of key QC statistics (median genes, sequencing saturation, etc.).
**Chemistry auto-detection**
Leave chemistry set to *Auto-detect* unless Cell Ranger fails to identify the library type. For single-nucleus experiments, enable *Include intronic reads*.
